coordinate_conventions.MagneticTB: Row lattice vectors; fractional direct positions and reciprocal k; rotations act on columns; periodic orbital gauge H_ij(k)=sum_R t_ij(R) exp(2πi k·R).
coordinate_conventions.CrystKit: Rational column coordinates; x_old=B*x_new+origin for basis changes.
